Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer misidentified John of Foix’s father as “Gaston II of Foix” based on a garbled/misread snippet, conflating the 14th-century Gaston II with the correct 15th-century Gaston IV (husband of Eleanor of Navarre). This unverified, erroneous lineage set the task off-course and led to the wrong paternal line, ultimately causing the incorrect final answer.
